title: Press release: fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 results (8-K exhibit 99.1)
quote: Fourth Quarter Summary (Compared with Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2025) • Net sales increased 8% to $176.8 million. On a constant currency basis, net sales increased 7% to $174.9 million. • Net sales of maintenance products increased 9% to $170.5 million. On a constant currency basis, maintenance product sales increased 8% to $168.8 million. • Gross margin decreased to 52.8% compared to 54.7%. • Selling, general and administrative expenses increased 19% to $58.2 million. • Advertising and sales promotion expenses increased 26% to $15.8 million. • Operating income decreased 32% to $19.1 million. • Net income decreased 32% to $14.4 million, and diluted earnings per share were $1.06, compared with $1.56.
